content.comment_body: Sorry, I am French from Belgium! I shared my latest application, which may interest users of [product_name] [article_no]. Here is the link: [url]. The app is a software solution for mobile devices to communicate with [product_name] [article_no] [company_name] model with Ethernet port. Connection is possible over WiFi or mobile data through Dynamic DNS. You can monitor all 850 bytes of memory—reading inputs, outputs, and handling data blocks and flags. Memory values can be of type bool, signed/unsigned integer (16/32 bit), and Real 32 bit. For communication, I used the "libnodave" library ([url]). If you encounter any problems, feel free to contact me via email. Please make sure you know what you're doing; the libnodave author warns the code is still beta and responsibility is yours. The "Lite" version is limited to 10 items per page, but page number is unlimited. The user manual in French is available here: [url].
Hello [user_name], why isn't it available for use on an Android tablet?
Hi [user_name], you should be able to use the app on a tablet. Are you experiencing issues?
[user_name], I tried installing it on a Fujitsu tablet with Android 4.0.3, but I received the message "Your device is not compatible with this version."
Understood—once again, an issue with Google Play. I can send the app to you via email. It should be compatible; I've tested it myself from Android 2.3 up to 4.0.3.
Hello [user_name], we also need this application for Apple iPhone. Is it difficult to create an iOS version? Thanks for your information. [user_name]
Hello, I am not developing for iOS at the moment since I lack the necessary tools, but I can assist if needed. Also, a multi-[product_name] [article_no] version will be available soon.
Hi [user_name], thanks for your information. But what do you mean by "available soon"? Is it 1 month, 1 week, or 1 year? Thank you. [user_name]
It's available now! Send your email if you'd like to test the new version.

Hi [user_name], thank you for your app—it's more useful than other similar apps. I'm trying it with my Nexus 7 tablet, but Google Play says it's not available for that device. Could you send it to me? Thanks for your effort! [user_name]
Hi! The APK for testing is a beta version. The final, optimized release for ICS is coming soon.
Hello, is there a tutorial for setting up [product_name] and the app?
@ [user_name], maybe it's best to use a reliable mobile device running Android OS ;-))) Regards.
On Nexus 7, I can't open it. Please send a download link. Thank you, [user_name].
Hi [user_name], thanks for sharing, but I don't see practical use. Who would need this app and for what reasons?

Hello, I use two [product_name] [article_no] units at home, and I'm happy to help with beta testing for the multi-device version. I have the same problem mentioned by others—Google Play reports my Samsung tablet isn't compatible. [user_name]
Hello, how can I write to [product_name] using this app? I can only receive the state of an input and would like to interact with an input or marker.

Hello [user_name], I am in education, and we have several [product_name] devices. We tested the application and it works with [article_no], but does not indicate communication for one of the [product_name]—there is no response when we try.
A video demonstration for my app is available: [url]. [user_name]
I have attached a quick start PDF.

Hello [user_name], thanks for your application. I've started using it and connected two [product_name] devices at my house. One is set up for watering and outdoor lights, and the other for heating and the alarm. Everything is working well. I finally figured out how to switch between different [product_name] units in the same project. Is it possible to set timer values in your app without accessing the [product_name] display? Which variables are usable for this purpose? Thank you again. [user_name] - Italy

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are interested in a mobile app for HMI tasks with [product_name] PLCs via Android devices. Several users encounter compatibility issues when attempting to install the app on certain Android tablets, even though the developer claims that it works on Android versions 2.3 to 4.0.3. There is also demand for an iOS version, but the developer is not currently supporting Apple devices.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the mobile HMI app to be straightforward to install and use on common Android devices, including tablets. They would also appreciate an option for iOS compatibility.
